builds.label: SSi Android wrapper — debug build (dev, 4 Sep evening)
builds.commitSubject: feat(provenance): a build says which commit it is and which origin it talks to
builds.provenanceNote: Built from commit 89af35fc, which is dev a7a3f68d (the belt-strip glyph, never-refuse navigation and two-strike network gate all included) merged with the Capacitor wrapper branch cs/516-android-dev-apk, plus this build's own provenance change. First APK whose Settings build row carries a real commit sha rather than a clock reading: after installing, that row reads 89af35fc, with the API host ssi-learning-app-git-dev-zenjin.vercel.app on a quiet second line. Web assets are BUNDLED into the APK — 'Tap to update' cannot fetch new web code, only a new APK can. sha256 verified against the bytes downloaded back out of the bucket.
